description: European Reference Model on Municipal Waste is published by EEA; Eionet. The reference model follows municipal-waste flows and estimates environmental pressures, costs and employment. Its stated coverage is EU27 and EU28 municipal-waste scenarios, 2015–2035; 2018 model version. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed XLSX resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Provider reuse conditions: acknowledge model and EU source, label user results and modifications, avoid implying endorsement; see provider page. The archived model description does not establish current distribution or calibration of every national application. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
